description: Use this when the user asks for the jobs (Stellen) they saved (Merkliste), here, on the website or in the app. Latest first, also jobs no longer among the matches. A job with `zustand` `verschwunden` is no longer advertised: tell the user so and do not offer to apply. `bewerbungsweg`: mail, apply by email via draft_job_application; formular, through the employer’s form via get_form_fields; kontakt, the ad names a contact person, get_form_fields says if there is a form; null, unknown, as formular. Never ask the user for a form’s fields. Link each job by its `stellenseite`, opening in app or browser. Scope: cv:lesen.
name: list_saved_jobs
title: List your saved jobs (gemerkte Stellen)
